question.text: Under SEBI's Stewardship Code for AIFs (Circular dated December 24, 2019), AIFs shall mandatorily follow a Stewardship Code in relation to their investment in:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 7.2 ESG Risk footnote 58: 'All AIFs shall mandatorily follow a Stewardship Code in relation to their investment in listed equities.' SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 dated December 24, 2019 applies to all MFs and AIFs. The Trap: Other securities classes are not covered — Stewardship is voting + engagement with INVESTEE companies which presumes listed-equity shareholder-level rights. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XIX-A, XV all test the Stewardship Code scope. Mutual funds have identical requirements — common exam territory. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even if your Cat II fund is primarily unlisted-equity focused, publish a light-touch Stewardship Policy covering the listed holdings acquired via PIPE or late-stage rounds — a gap here is a cheap SEBI inspection finding to avoid.
